evidence: The exact-pinned _SourceIdAssigner calls unique_source_id for new unmapped names and unique_environment_source_id for environment-scoped IDs; both use path_segment with the fixed production fallbacks resource/default.
DirectoryManifestAdapter and EnvironmentScopedManifestAdapter form repository-relative source paths from source IDs; WorkspaceSyncService consumes adapter source paths during export.
adoption.rationale: A narrow component guarantee is useful because newly minted workspace-sync source IDs become repository-relative names. The contract covers only path_segment outputs through exact production calls and does not claim attacker reachability, export-root confinement, collision freedom, or a deployed security issue.

contract.declared_domain: All Python str values passed to the exact pinned path_segment helper through unique_source_id or unique_environment_source_id. Production call sites use the default fallback "resource" or the literal environment fallback "default". The input includes empty strings, separators, NUL, line breaks, arbitrary Unicode, and arbitrary length.
contract.guarantee: For each path_segment invocation through the stated production call sites, the returned value is nonempty, at most 96 characters, contains only ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen, and is neither "." nor "..". It therefore contributes one relative path component. unique_environment_source_id intentionally composes two such components with one slash between them. This contract does not prove export-root enforcement, symlink behavior, collisions, or Git-provider path handling.
contract.input_source: Workspace resource names and environment names are persisted workspace configuration. For unmapped resources, _SourceIdAssigner uses unique_source_id or unique_environment_source_id to mint source IDs; these call path_segment with only the pinned production fallbacks "resource" and "default". Adapters consume the resulting component(s) in repository-relative source paths. Existing mapped source IDs bypass this helper and are outside the contract.

domain: Each output character from the pinned path_segment substitution belongs to its ASCII path-component alphabet
